title: FridayToolDefinition
description: Definition and security policy specification for native and MCP tools in Friday.

name.description: Namespaced tool name, e.g. filesystem.read, git.status, terminal.exec.

description.description: Clear documentation for the model and UI on what the tool does.

risk_level.description: 0 = Read-only / safe within root, 1 = Safe write with checkpoint, 2 = Execution / high impact, 3 = Critical / denied by default.

requires_native_approval.description: Whether execution requires a native OS approval dialog from Rust.

parameters.description: JSON Schema object representing expected tool arguments.
